Name: Jeduthun
Summary: Jeduthun was a musician named in the titles of Psalms 39, 62, and 77, psalms of waiting, silence, and remembered deliverance.
KeyStory: His psalms counsel quiet trust: waiting silently for God alone, remembering God's wonders of old when the present feels empty.
KeyVerses: Psalm 39:1; Psalm 62:1; 1 Chronicles 16:41; 1 Chronicles 25:1; Nehemiah 11:17; 2 Chronicles 5:12; 2 Chronicles 29:14; 2 Chronicles 35:15
RelatedPeople: Asaph; Heman, Son of Joel; King Josiah
LifeLesson: Jeduthun's music teaches stillness — sometimes the most faithful thing is to wait silently for God rather than speak.
